test_data_parallel_pause_resume: test coordinated pause and resume of a vLLM server across multiple data parallel ranks via HTTP API
run_pause_generation: run pause_generation to pause a vLLM server mid-streaming generation via the /pause HTTP endpoint
run_resume_generation: run resume_generation to resume a previously paused vLLM server via the /resume HTTP endpoint
run_main_cli: run the main CLI entry point to execute the full data parallel pause/resume test with streaming token generation
review_generator_thread: review the generator_thread function that streams tokens and records timestamps for pause gap verification
